title: Pitman–Koopman–Darmois converse
reason: The cited source states the converse with regularity conditions, but this article's Proof box proves only the forward exponential-family results. A reviewed converse proof is still needed.

title: Large-sample frequentist coverage of Bayesian central intervals
reason: The source states asymptotic correspondence under regularity conditions; a complete Bernstein–von Mises argument is outside the article's finite-sample proof.

title: Pitman–Koopman–Darmois converse for sufficient statistics
reason: The page proves factorization and Basu’s theorem, but a full converse needs the cited regularity and common-support argument.

title: Dominated-space converse of Fisher–Neyman factorization
reason: The proof gives both directions for discrete samples and outlines the conditional-kernel argument, but not the full measure-theoretic dominated-space construction.

title: General asymptotic Kullback–Leibler optimism correction for AIC
reason: The article proves the exact 2d correction for correctly specified known-variance Gaussian linear models. The stated general regular-likelihood result needs a separate asymptotic expansion and assumptions on identifiability and misspecification.

title: Finite irreducible chains have a unique positive stationary distribution and converge when aperiodic
reason: The page cites Levin and Peres, §1.5.3 and Theorem 4.9, but its local proof covers only the path criterion and communication relation. A self-contained proof of the finite stationary and convergence claims is deferred.

title: General multivariate density change of variables
reason: The local proof checks linear volume scaling, the triangular marginal and a one-dimensional two-branch example. A full analytic proof of the differentiable bijection change-of-variables theorem stated in the definition is deferred; Cambridge Statistics 1B, §1.13, states it.

title: Finite irreducible aperiodic Markov-chain convergence
reason: The article mentions convergence of finite irreducible aperiodic chains. Its local proof derives path probabilities and Chapman–Kolmogorov, while the full convergence theorem is cited to Levin and Peres, §4.3, and deferred.

title: Beta law from independent gamma variables
reason: The related-distributions paragraph states the gamma ratio construction; a full Jacobian proof is available in Siegrist §5.17 but is not in this page's single source proof box.

title: Mercer eigen-expansion under analytic conditions
reason: The interpretation mentions Mercer's theorem; this page's single proof covers the finite-Gram/feature-space equivalence. A separate proof with the theorem's domain, continuity and integrability assumptions remains needed.

title: Positive definiteness of the Gaussian radial kernel
reason: The worked example verifies only a two-point Gram matrix; Schölkopf and Smola §8 state the general Gaussian kernel result, but a proof for all finite input lists is not included in the page's one proof box.

title: Iid strong law under finite first absolute moment
reason: The statement includes the strong law, while the single proof covers the finite-variance weak law only. Siegrist §6.3 gives a strong-law proof under finite variance and points to the broader integrable theorem.

title: Four order-and-replacement counting rules
reason: The properties section table gives four formulas without proof on this page; the single proof covers the equal-likelihood rule. A dedicated linked result page treats counting draws.

title: Convergence and Monte Carlo error of the dependent chain
reason: The proof establishes detailed balance and invariance, while convergence from a chosen start and uncertainty for dependent averages need additional recurrence and Markov-chain limit arguments.

title: Existence, uniqueness and return times in finite irreducible chains
reason: The page states Corollary 1.17 and Proposition 1.19 of Levin and Peres; the proof derives the balance shortcuts but does not prove these recurrence results.

title: Aperiodic convergence and closed-class decomposition
reason: The page states Theorem 4.9 and finite closed-class mixture results; their full proofs require coupling and communication-class theory beyond the displayed proof.

title: BIC consistency in particular singular mixture models
reason: The page states a qualified consistency claim for some mixtures. Its proof establishes only the regular Laplace expansion, not a singular-mixture consistency theorem.

title: Beta–Binomial conjugacy
reason: The proof establishes the binomial mass function and moments but does not derive the beta-posterior update.

title: Beta–Binomial posterior prediction
reason: The proof does not integrate the beta–binomial predictive formula.

title: Poisson limit of the binomial
reason: The proof does not establish the Poisson limit for fixed counts.

title: Central limit theorem
reason: The proof does not establish the normal limit.

title: Gamma prior update for exponential rate
reason: The Bayesian example states a Gamma posterior, but the proof does not derive it.

title: Exponential versus Gamma marginal likelihoods
reason: The model-comparison example states the two integrated marginal likelihood formulas, but the proof does not derive them.

title: Higher moments and entropy
reason: The proof derives mean, variance, MGF, quantile and minimum law, but does not derive skewness, excess kurtosis or differential entropy.

title: Asymptotic inverse-information covariance of the maximum likelihood estimator
reason: The page states the regular large-sample covariance approximation, but the proof covers the information identity, additivity, and Cramér–Rao inequality only.

title: Cover–Hart risk bound
reason: The page states an asymptotic risk claim. Its proof establishes only finite-sample vote algebra and does not prove Breiman's risk bound.

title: Bayes consistency of growing nearest-neighbour votes
reason: The page describes k growing with sample size and k/n tending to zero but does not prove consistency under regularity conditions.

title: Marginal posterior after learning normal hyperparameters
reason: The page proves the conditional normal update but does not derive a general marginal posterior after integrating uncertain population mean and between-group variance.

title: Rat-tumour beta hierarchy
reason: The preserved linked worked example derives a beta-binomial hyperposterior; the single proof on this theorem page concerns normal group means, so the beta-hierarchy derivation remains outside its proof box.

title: Pearson reference law after grouped-data parameter estimation
reason: The page states the regular chi-squared k-1-r limit, but its proof derives the fixed-probability k-1 case and the likelihood-ratio expansion only.

title: Student posterior prediction under the normal regression reference prior
reason: The properties state the multivariate regression Student distribution and scale, while the page's proof covers predictive mixtures, variance decomposition, and beta–binomial prediction; the regression calculation needs a complete derivation.

title: Almost-everywhere derivative of an indefinite integral
reason: The proof establishes interval probabilities, point masses and continuity, and cites the standard differentiation theorem for the general assertion F'=f almost everywhere; a full proof of that theorem is beyond this page.

title: Converse de Finetti representation for infinitely exchangeable Bernoulli sequences
reason: The proof establishes that iid Bernoulli mixtures are exchangeable and gives a finite counterexample; it does not derive the converse via limiting empirical-frequency measures and uniqueness.

title: General finite-normal-mixture identifiability up to permutation
reason: The proof establishes label symmetry and elementary rank examples, but it does not prove Teicher's general finite-normal-mixture identification result under distinct components and positive weights.

title: Rothenberg local information criterion under regularity conditions
reason: The page explains and illustrates the criterion but does not reproduce the full regular-point proof from the original paper.

title: Completeness of a full-rank exponential-family natural statistic
reason: The definition states the full-rank completeness result but the page proof covers moment identities and parameter reparameterization, not Laplace-transform uniqueness needed for completeness. A separate exact proof with its integrability assumptions is required.

title: Tukey simultaneous-interval coverage for all pairwise means
reason: The proof covers the ANOVA decomposition, F reference law and two-group t relation; the Tukey studentized-range simultaneous coverage statement is not proved there.

title: Planned-contrast F distribution
reason: The prose gives a one-dimensional normal-square argument, but a complete derivation of contrast independence from pooled error and its exact F law remains to be added.

title: Adaptive lasso oracle properties
reason: The article reports Zou's conditional asymptotic oracle properties. Its proof concerns soft thresholding and does not establish the asymptotic design, pilot-estimator and penalty-rate conditions.

title: Poisson modal counts
reason: The infobox mode formula and new ratio interpretation are algebraically checked, but no proof specifically derives the mode.

title: Poisson skewness and excess kurtosis
reason: The infobox states skewness and excess kurtosis. The proof concerns independent sums, and the higher-moment formulas are not derived there.

title: Fisher information for a Poisson mean
reason: The infobox states information 1/lambda per observation; a worked calculation derives it, but the article's proof does not.

title: General Slater strong-duality theorem for convex programmes
reason: The page verifies strict feasibility for the finite hard-margin primal and derives its dual/KKT conditions, but invokes the general Slater theorem for zero duality gap rather than proving that theorem.

title: Pooled normal scatter Wishart law and independence of group means
reason: The page states (n1+n2−2)S has Wishart law and is independent of the two sample means. The added Proof proves pooling/unbiasedness/rank but does not derive the normal orthogonal-projection Wishart decomposition; give a full proof on this page or a linked theorem page.

title: Two-sample Hotelling T-squared F calibration
reason: The page states the exact F law and critical value. The added Proof does not derive the independent normal/Wishart quadratic-form law or the F scaling; prove this under p<n1+n2−1 and common positive-definite covariance.

title: GEE consistency and sandwich covariance under working-correlation misspecification
reason: The article proves the estimating equation is unbiased at a correct marginal mean, but a reviewed independent-cluster asymptotic argument is still needed to establish consistency and sandwich convergence under the stated regularity and missingness conditions.

title: Uniqueness of an MGF on a neighbourhood of zero
reason: The article proves derivative and independence identities but invokes, without proving, uniqueness of the bilateral Laplace transform on a neighbourhood of zero.

title: Recurrence type across communicating states and stationary return identity
reason: The article proves finite closed-class positive recurrence and geometric visit counts. The class-wide positive or null classification, and the identity π_i=1/E_i T_i^+, are not given a full proof.

title: Hammersley–Clifford
reason: The equivalence of the pairwise Markov property and clique factorisation for a positive distribution is longer than a short proof box.

title: Multivariate central limit theorem
reason: The iid vector limit, including the Cramér–Wold argument under finite covariance, is longer than a short proof box.

title: Normal sample theorem
reason: The chi-squared law and the independence of the sample mean and variance use an orthogonal transformation of the standard normal vector. That argument is longer than a short proof box.

title: Wishart null distribution of Hotelling's T squared
reason: The page shows the one-dimensional reduction and the numerical F transform. It does not derive the normal-sample Wishart calibration.

title: Hammersley–Clifford equivalence
reason: The page proves a Gaussian path factorisation for one precision matrix. The general equivalence between a positive density's clique factorisation and its pairwise Markov property is not derived.

title: Cauchy sample averages do not settle
reason: The page shows the mean is undefined. The implication for the strong law is not proved separately.

title: Natural cubic spline minimises the penalised residual sum of squares
reason: The page proves the infinite-penalty limit, the least-squares line. It does not prove that the minimiser is a natural cubic spline with knots at the distinct inputs.

title: Conditional covariance is the inverse precision block
reason: The page uses the Gaussian identity and simplifies the correlation. The identity is not derived from the normal density here.

title: Basu independence
reason: The page proves ancillarity of the centred vector for a location parameter. It does not prove independence from a complete sufficient statistic.

title: False-discovery-rate bound
reason: The page does not prove that the false discovery rate is at most (M0/M) alpha under independence.

title: Convergence of transition powers
reason: The page proves P^{m+n}=P^m P^n. It does not prove convergence of P^n.

title: Multiparameter Cramér–Rao bound
reason: The page proves the scalar inequality. A matrix bound for a vector parameter is not proved.

title: Dominated-family converse
reason: The page proves the discrete direction. The converse on a general dominated space is not proved.

title: Successive orthogonal directions
reason: The page proves the one-direction score identity. It does not prove by induction that later directions are the remaining eigenvectors.

title: KKT characterisation of the soft-margin solution
reason: The page proves the smallest feasible slack for a fixed plane. It does not prove the KKT characterisation of the minimiser.

title: Density of the studentised range
reason: The page proves that coverage is the event that the range is at most Q. It does not derive the density of the studentised range.

title: Uniqueness under completeness
reason: The page proves unbiasedness of the Poisson conditional probability. It does not prove that completeness makes that function the unique unbiased function of the sum.

title: Asymptotic standard-normal null distribution
reason: The page computes normal tail probabilities. It does not prove the normal limit of the logistic estimator.

title: Albert–Anderson existence theorem
reason: The page proves an intercept-free one-predictor case. The general separating-hyperplane theorem is not given a proof.

title: Hammersley–Clifford converse
reason: The page proves the forward path case. It does not prove that a positive pairwise Markov distribution factorises.

title: REML for a general linear mixed model
reason: The page maximises the chi-squared likelihood of a single normal sample. The general contrast likelihood for several variance components is not derived.

title: Variance-ratio and ANOVA F laws
reason: The page proves that the reciprocal of an F ratio is F with the degrees of freedom swapped. It does not prove the variance-ratio pivot or the ANOVA F distribution.

title: Chi-squared limit under estimated independence margins
reason: The page proves the degree-of-freedom count (r-1)(c-1). It does not prove that the Pearson statistic converges to that chi-squared law.

title: Stopping time and weight decay
reason: For a quadratic error and a gradient path from the origin, the product of iteration index and learning rate plays the role of the reciprocal penalty. The page records the similarity and does not prove that identification.

title: Convergence under decreasing step sizes
reason: The page states step-size conditions for stochastic approximation without proving that those conditions make the iterates converge.

title: Coverage of the plug-in binomial interval
reason: The page uses the normal limit at p=1/2 with the true standard error. It does not prove that replacing the standard error by the estimate keeps the coverage near 95% for a general p.

title: Critical Galton–Watson extinction
reason: Durrett Theorem 4.3.11 covers the critical case m=1 with P(ξ=1)<1. The martingale argument is not written on the page.

title: Sample-path proof of L=λW
reason: The page uses L=λW. A sample-path argument for the identity is not given.

title: Pairwise second Borel–Cantelli lemma
reason: Durrett Theorem 2.3.9, the pairwise form of the second lemma, is not proved on the page.

title: Extreme-value classification
reason: The three explicit tail calculations are proved. The theorem that every non-degenerate affine limit of a maximum is Gumbel, Fréchet or Weibull is not proved.

title: Stationarity for the Hastings ratio
reason: The page does not prove that the target distribution is stationary for the Hastings ratio.

title: Hammersley–Clifford equivalence for a positive density
reason: The path example is proved from the conditional product. The general equivalence is not proved.

title: Benjamini–Hochberg under independence
reason: Bonferroni's union bound is proved on the page. The Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate bound under independence is not proved.

title: Null chi-squared laws of the block and treatment sums of squares
reason: The page uses the F reference distribution for one table. The normal-theory chi-squared derivation is not given.

title: Wold representation by the closed linear past
reason: The page explains innovation orthogonality and verifies an MA(1) and a stationary harmonic. A complete Hilbert-space construction of the infinite moving-average representation and deterministic component remains to be supplied.

title: Convergence to the one-neighbour limiting risk
reason: The article derives the risk inequalities from the limiting conditional-label formula and explains its continuity argument. The general Euclidean nearest-neighbour convergence argument, including measurable distance ties, remains to be supplied.

title: Regular finite-chain convergence to the uniform stationary law
reason: The article proves uniform invariance and checks a regular-chain example, but does not give the general regular finite-chain convergence proof.

title: Poisson convergence for unequal independent Bernoulli probabilities
reason: The article proves the identical-probability binomial case. Its stated triangular-array extension is cited to Durrett Thm.3.6.1 without a full independent-array proof.

title: Exact normal-sample Hotelling F calibration
reason: The page derives and checks ellipsoid geometry and numerically applies the stated normal-sample F calibration; a full Wishart/independent-mean derivation of that calibration is not given.

title: Slater constraint qualification and strong duality
reason: The article proves weak duality and derives the SVM dual; it cites the general Slater strong-duality theorem without its separation argument.

title: Convergence for a countable irreducible aperiodic positive recurrent chain
reason: The local contraction proof establishes finite-state convergence only. The countable-state extension is stated from Durrett §5.6 Thm5.6.6 and needs the recurrence/coupling argument.

title: Long-run visit proportions for an irreducible positive recurrent chain
reason: State-frequency convergence is stated from Durrett §5.6 Thm5.6.1, separately from distributional convergence; its return-cycle strong-law proof is not included.

title: Poisson arrivals see stationary occupancy probabilities
reason: The finite occupancy distribution is derived by detailed balance. The general nonanticipating Poisson-arrival sampling theorem is stated from Wolff (1982), §§1–2, without reproducing its martingale proof.

title: A characteristic function uniquely determines its probability law
reason: The article derives basic transform identities and a finite-law worked example. General uniqueness via Fourier inversion is stated from Durrett §3.3.1 and is not proved.

title: Pointwise transform convergence and continuity at zero imply weak convergence
reason: The continuity theorem is stated with its continuity-at-zero hypothesis from Durrett Thm. 3.3.17; the tightness and inversion proof is not reproduced.

title: Gumbel limit for independent normal maxima
reason: The page proves the exact exponential maximum limit. The normal-tail comparison cites Durrett Exercise 3.2.3 but does not establish its tail-ratio asymptotics.

title: Convergence of finite irreducible aperiodic transition powers
reason: The page proves existence, positivity and uniqueness of the stationary law and derives the two-state limit. The general aperiodic convergence and return-time theorems are cited to Durrett §§5.5–5.6 rather than proved.

title: Stationary masses equal reciprocal mean return times
reason: The page applies the return-time identity from Durrett Theorem 5.5.11; its local proof establishes stationary existence and uniqueness without deriving this renewal identity.

title: Extension of consistent finite-dimensional laws
reason: The page verifies finite Bernoulli consistency and Markov marginalisation; the measure-extension existence argument for arbitrary consistent laws is stated with Durrett Appendix A.3 as its source.

title: Hull–Dobell full-period theorem
reason: The full-period conditions are stated with Hull and Dobell (1962), Theorem 1, p. 233. The page checks two finite cycles rather than proving the modular-arithmetic characterization.

title: Variance of the unbiased sample variance
reason: The page proves unbiasedness and the sample-mean moments. The fourth-central-moment formula for Var(S²) is cited to Siegrist and checked by finite enumeration for a discrete population; its general combinatorial proof is not included.

title: Full asymptotic Laplace approximation with tail control
reason: The article evaluates the Gaussian surrogate exactly and checks an exact gamma-integral example; a general analytic proof controlling Taylor remainders and contributions outside the dominant peak is still required.

title: Regular likelihood-ratio chi-square calibration for nested GLMs
reason: The article proves the exact Gaussian orthogonal-coordinate case; the general regular-model likelihood asymptotic expansion and convergence proof remain to be supplied.

title: General two-sample Hotelling F calibration
reason: The page proves affine invariance and the scalar t-squared case; the multivariate normal/Wishart derivation for arbitrary dimension is cited to the proper full-text papers rather than derived.

title: Weakest-link pruning gives the nested optimal-subtree path
reason: The page proves penalty monotonicity of leaf counts and the single-branch breakpoint identity. The full optimal-subtree guarantee for successive weakest-link pruning is cited to Loh2014 but has no local structural proof.
